channel.title: VibeDispatcher
channel.description: Updates for VibeDispatcher — voice-driven command center for macOS.

item.description:
v0.0.6 — Happy absorption Phases 1+2+3+4 + release pipeline fix.

This release lands the full Happy-pairing-and-voice absorption (mac + iOS + relay + ConvAI engine) and fixes the silent-failure release pipeline that caused v0.0.3 / v0.0.4 / v0.0.5 to ship without auto-update prompts.

  • Phase 4 — ConvAI engine for Mac TTS stack. Optional ElevenLabs conversational-AI voice engine selectable via config.yaml: convai_enabled + convai_agent_id. Onboarding alert on first launch when configured. Falls back to native voice on 402/451.
  • Phase 1 — Voice routes on relay (token issuance + ElevenLabs circuit breakers + BIPA / IL geo-block).
  • Phase 2 — Server libsodium (pairing primitive + socket.io broadcast + Expo push). Server-side; users see ConvAI option in VD.
  • Phase 3 — Beacon iOS pairing UI + WireKit (libsodium) + APNs registration. Sideloaded to iPhone for testing; pairing-flow plumbing landed.
  • Release pipeline hardening (Issue #643). scripts/release.sh now mandatorily pushes the canonical appcast at the end of release; build FAILS if push fails. New CI workflow release-appcast-verify.yml double-checks the published appcast within 5 min of release publish. TRAPS §7 documents the Sparkle "you're ahead" silent-failure mode this fix prevents.

Full release notes: github.com/williamruiz1/vibedispatcher/releases/tag/v0.0.6

Notarized rebuild — same code as 0.0.1, but Apple notarization now passes. No more "can't verify the developer" warning on first launch.

Sparkle should pull this update silently if you're already on 0.0.1.

Full release notes: github.com/williamruiz1/vibedispatcher/releases/tag/v0.0.2

Fresh-start rebuild absorbing Claude Code Jarvis V into VibeDispatcher.

Highlights: Terminal Voice (local Piper Atlas voice for Claude Code CLI), Main Window with Sessions/Voice/Beacon/Settings tabs, Ice-style permissions onboarding, live transcript pane with hallucination filter, all API keys in macOS Keychain, Sparkle EdDSA keypair rotated, cloudflared SHA-256 pinned.

Pre-1.0 versioning intentional — VD is in active rebuild for v2.0+. The 0.0.x series signals "anything can break" while we shake out the absorption + UI consolidation.

Full release notes: github.com/williamruiz1/vibedispatcher/releases/tag/v0.0.1

Note: signed but NOT notarized in this release (notarytool credential profile setup pending). On first launch you'll get a Gatekeeper warning — right-click → Open to bypass once.
